{{Quote|The Mandalorians have lost their way. They didn't remain committed. I will show them our unbroken history of honor that yet remains. A hidden chain of proud tradition waiting to drag the unworthy down. We have chosen a side in this battle. And we fight to win.|Field Marshal Heta Kol|<ref name="Spirit of Vengeance">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=flashpoint|Spirit of Vengeance}}</ref>}}
The '''Hidden Chain''' was an organization created by [[Heta Kol]] around [[3626 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|6.2}}</ref> It was founded on an unswerving belief that [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] should use their skills in war to further their own agenda, rather than acting as [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] for hire. This belief appealed to many clans that had split away from [[Mandalore the Avenger]]'s forces,<ref name="SWTOR" /> known as the [[Mandalorian Trat'ade]].<ref name="Track">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=other|"Mandalorian Trat'ade on Ruhnuk" Reputation Track}}</ref>

After founding the Hidden Chain, Kol took on the title of [[Field Marshal/Legends|Field Marshal]] as a tribute to the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Neo-Crusader]] movement from [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] past. The name "Hidden Chain" referred to the hidden chain of proud Mandalorian traditions waiting to drag the unworthy down.<ref name="Spirit of Vengeance" />

==History==
{{Quote|In Shae Vizla, I see only hypocrisy. She has driven out those who oppose her view, yet she has remade the Mandalorians into servants of anyone who pays her enough credits--no matter what they believe. Where is the honor in that?|Field Marshal Heta Kol|<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]''</ref>}}
It is unknown exactly when the Hidden Chain was formed but it was confirmed, by [[Rass Ordo]], to be operational two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to the [[Showdown on Ruhnuk]] when a small group led by [[Ri'kan Kateen]] were hired by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] for an unknown mission on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] but they encountered a second Mandalorian team, led by [[Layla Ordo]], hired by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] which ended in the failure of the Imperial mission and Layla's death.<ref name="showdown">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Showdown on Ruhnuk|[[Ruhnuk]]}}</ref>

[[File:Hidden_Chain.jpg|thumb|250px|right|Heta Kol and the Hidden Chain]]
The Hidden Chain remained operational during the [[Third Galactic War]] where Heta Kol had been able to recruit many individuals from rogue and exiled Mandalorian clans that she began to use sneak attacks on various Mandalorian vessels out on patrol or escort missions to test the strength of Shae's fleet.<ref name="Meeting Jekiah">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=general|Meeting Jekiah Ordo|[[Odessen]]}}</ref> It was not until the [[Attack on the Spirit of Vengeance II|attack]] on the ''[[Spirit of Vengeance II]]'', when the Hidden Chain announced itself to Shae Vizla, whom the organization declared unfit to rule the Mandalorians, and succeeded in stealing the Cadera banner.<ref name="Spirit of Vengeance" />

After the attack on the ''Spirit of Vengeance II'', Heta Kol knew that Shae would neglect her duties as Mandalore and focus only on hunting the traitorous Mandalorian so Heta had set up false leads and eliminating loose ends to make Shae's job hard<ref name="Whispers in the Force">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=general|Whispers in the Force|[[Odessen]]}}</ref> and in the meantime the Hidden Chain regained Ri'kan Kateen as Heta's second-in-command and his sister, [[Sa'har Kateen]], a former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] who sought to reunite with her brother by aiding the Hidden Chain.<ref name="Digging Deeper" />

[[File:Hidden_Chain_fleet.jpg|thumb|250px|left|The Hidden Chain fleet]]
Sometime after the capture of [[Darth Malgus]], [[Mandalore the Avenger|Shae Vizla]] had seemingly managed to locate [[Ruhnuk]] and enlisted the help of the [[Alliance Commander]] to put an end to the Hidden Chain. The duo managed to sneak their way in, only to be outsmarted by Heta Kol, who agreed to a duel requested by Shae to show who is stronger and whose way is the right way. The duel ended abruptly when the full might of Shae's forces arrived on Ruhnuk which led to a [[Showdown on Ruhnuk|decisive battle]] against the Hidden Chain. The Hidden Chain were losing the battle which led to the majority of their forces to full retreat whilst Heta abandoned Ruhnuk as a base of operations.<ref name="showdown" />

The Hidden Chain were present in a meeting with Heta, Ri'Kan, Sa'har and the other leaders where Heta discussed the events on Ruhnuk and how she found out that Bask Sunn had betrayed them by sabotaging her duel against Shae to maximize his profits, excommunicating the entirety of Dar'manda as their enemy. Heta further explained how using [[Darth Nul's holocron]] would further advance their final objective and that, in the future, only Heta and Sa'har would possess the full knowledge of the plan to avoid any attempts at undermining the Hidden Chain.<ref name="old wounds">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Old Wounds|[[Carrick Station]]}}</ref>

[[File:HiddenChainPortNowhere.png|thumb|250px|right|The Hidden Chain, in their new uniform, on Port Nowhere]]
The Hidden Chain, now wearing standardized uniform, would later launch [[Hidden Chain raids|multiple attacks]] across the galaxy, prompting Shae's forces to scramble to neutralize them, spreading the loyalists thin. One such [[Raid on Port Nowhere|attack]] on [[Port Nowhere]], was thwarted by the Alliance Commander and Rass Ordo, resulting in the loss of [[Cantis Bralor]].<ref name="Nowhere" />

Subsequently, the Hidden Chain, led by [[Tyrus Brokenblade]], [[Raid on Kessan's Landing|traveled]] to [[Kessan's Landing]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], where they partnered with the local [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]]<ref name="Nowhere" /> to steal cooling rods from the local geothermal station as well as civilians bold enough to stand up the separatists. The Hidden Chain were only able to escape with half of their assets due to the interference of the Alliance Commander and Petra Nihrum. Tyrus personally faced off against the interlopers, nearly killing Nihrum when Sa'har unexpectedly interfered. After they defeated Tyrus and stopped him from warning Heta of her betrayal, Sa'har informed the Commander that Heta was plotting to build a [[Holocron Machine|machine]] from the blueprints on Darth Nul's holocron and that she was going to steal it back to put a stop to her plans.<ref name="Storm">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Storming the Castle|[[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]}}</ref>

As Hidden Chain attacks increase, drawing concern from the upper levels of both Republic and Empire, Sa'har made her plans after overhearing Ri'kan discussing a Hidden Chain team trapped in the [[Minboosa District]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Hutta]], getting caught up in the local slave revolt against [[Vobbara Yusinduu]]. Arranging a discreet rendezvous with the Alliance Commander on [[Mek-Sha]], she revealed Heta's plans; Heta had recreated Nul's machine, which had reawakened the Force in the Hidden Chain's captives, hoping to create a Force-wielding army to bolster her cause, and intended for Sa'har to train her conscripts.<ref name="Desperate Defiance">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Desperate Defiance|Odessen}}</ref>

Both Sa'har and the Commander then traveled to Hutta and ended up aiding the rebel slaves to seize the Hidden Chain shuttle needed to access Heta's flagship while decimating the Hidden Chain forces trapped in the underground tunnels. Afterwards, they infiltrated the prison ship, sabotaged the communications, freed the prisoners, before being confronted by Ri'kan at the reactor. The resulting duel caused catastrophic damage to the ship. Both Kateen siblings were trapped on the exploding flagship and presumed dead while the Commander escaped with the holocron.<ref name="Sundering">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Sundering|Hidden Chain Ship}}</ref>

Meanwhile, growing conflict between the Mandalorians convinced Shae that if the Hidden Chain were allowed to continue as they were, both the Republic and the Empire would be driven to destroy the Mandalorians, regardless of which faction they belonged to. In desperation, she hired a mercenary team to aid her in [[Malgus's escape|freeing]] Malgus, believing he would know where to find Heta.<ref name="Sundering" /> Malgus would later aid Shae and her team in [[Attack on a Hidden Chain base|attacking a Hidden Chain base]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], decimating the soldiers stationed there.<ref name="Galactic Threads">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Galactic Threads|Odessen}}</ref>

As a result of their flagship's destruction, Hidden Chain command fell into chaos. Another team bring in more Force-sensitive prisoners was ordered to hold position. However, [[Jemala Ha'rangir]], who had fallen in love with one of the prisoners, [[Ora Nem]], turned on her team and set all the prisoners free on Tatooine. In response, Heta hired [[Raal's Regulators]] to recapture the escaped prisoners, including Jemala. The couple were secretly aided by [[Darth Jadus]], who faked a distress call to [[Jekiah Ordo]], who sent the Commander and [[Akaavi Spar]] to Tatooine. Reaching an agreement with Jemala, the Commander and Spar defeated [[Sanlo Raal]] and her Regulators. In exchange, Jemala revealed that Heta was somehow moving through Imperial space unopposed with the aid of an unknown benefactor. Furthermore, she revealed that some amongst the Hidden Chain were growing uneasy with Heta's capabilities and leadership, with her recent setbacks doing little to alleviate these doubts.<ref name="On the Run">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|On the Run|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref>

Darth Jadus would later reveal his involvement to the Commander, as he stated that Heta Kol was unknowingly helping bring Malgus' plan to reawaken the Force in many and fundamentally upend the Jedi and the Sith. He also shared an image of Ri'kan bringing a captive Sa'har to Hidden Chain soldiers.<ref name="Dark Heart">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Dark Heart of the Fortress|[[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]]}}</ref>

==Organization==
{{Quote|We all want something enough to bleed for it--reputation, honor, credits, whatever. That conviction binds us together. Makes us equal. So I'll need everyone to stay committed to each other. Like our lives depend on it.|Heta Kol|<ref name="Spirit of Vengeance" />}}
The Hidden Chain's structure as an organization is unique as it is comprised of various rogue Mandalorian clans who willingly follow Heta Kol but are also under no obligation to abandon all personal interest.<ref name="Spirit of Vengeance" /> The individual clans that comprise the main force of the Hidden Chain follow their respective clan leader who in turn follow the orders of Heta Kol or Ri'kan Kateen, in Heta's absence. Additionally, not in Heta's presence, the clans tend to not get along well with others due to their unique creed that the clans are notorious for not mixing well with others.<ref name="interference" />

[[File:Ashad_and_Clan_Varad.jpg|thumb|250px|right|Ash'ad and Clan Varad fighting on Ruhnuk]]
*'''Field Marshal''': [[Heta Kol]]&dagger;.<ref name="Spirit of Vengeance" />
*'''Second-in-Command''': [[Ri'kan Kateen]] (defected).<ref name="signals" />
*'''Dar'manda''' leader: [[Bask Sunn]].&dagger;<ref name="Spirit of Vengeance" />
*'''Ash'ad''' leader: [[Durn Wynnward]].<ref name="Spirit of Vengeance" />
*'''Clan Varad''' leader: [[Tyrus Brokenblade]].<ref name="Spirit of Vengeance" />
*'''Clan Ha'rangir''' leader: [[Kur Ha'rangir]].

Although Sa'har Kateen is not an official Hidden Chain member, she answers only to Ri'kan and Heta due to special circumstances.<ref name="interference">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Outside Interference|[[Ruhnuk]]}}</ref>. Due to Sa'har's [[Mission to Hidden Chain Ship|actions]], she has been arrested as a traitor by the Hidden Chain.<ref name="Masters Enigma" />
